title: gitdone plan
description: Everything about a project that its status table cannot say about itself. Paths are relative to this file, and ~ is the home directory.

status_doc.description: The status table: the only place a row's status changes.

status_out.description: The generated view. Default STATUS.md. It must not be the table or the plan.

badge.description: A badge file to keep with the view. It is written whenever the view is, and the gate holds it to the table.

footer.description: Words for the end of the view. `init` puts a link to the tool here; it is yours to change or delete.

release.description: Words for the release line in the view's header.

release_sha.description: Which commit counts as the release, when `release` names several.

repo.description: The repository evidence is checked against.

default_branch.description: The branch a Live row's commit must be on.

branch_aliases.description: Short names a status cell may use for branches.

evidence_pattern.description: A regular expression that also counts as naming a release. A named group `ref` is held to the commit rules as a commit id or a tag, never a branch. Any other match is only reported, and --strict does not count it.

verdict_state.description: A Verdict state.json, read and never written. Its record goes to the terminal, never into the view.

deadline.description: A date. The view states it, `eta` measures against it, and moving it is said out loud.

start.description: When the work began, for the time bar. Default: the table's first commit.

requirements.description: Markdown files inside the project that hold what was asked for: `REQ-12: words`, or checklist items.

paths.description: A row, a range or a workstream, to the file patterns that are its work.

upkeep.description: File patterns that count as upkeep. Replaces the default list.

generated_by.description: The command words in the view's header.

regenerate.description: The command a person runs to regenerate the view.

noun.description: The word after a group's total.

scale.description: The words of the scale paragraph. Default: generated from the kinds.

rows_total.description: The table's row count. Set it to make a change of scope a deliberate edit.

kinds.description: The ordered statuses, at least two. The first is what strict counts, so it must have "evidence": "release"; the last is what a prose domain's rows count as.

evidence.description: What a row of this kind must name.

groups.description: Sets of domains measured on their own.

workstreams.description: The queue: named sets of rows, with their state and what they need.

order.description: Workstream ids. Default: their order in the list.

sections.description: What the view shows after its header, in order.

from.description: The name of any list in this plan.

products.description: Rows of a measure table: static, or computed from a group or rows.

numbers.description: A number, a list of numbers, or a range string like "1-11,14".
